actions.description:
A creature fails a Charisma-based skill check against the political upstart

Effect The political upstart targets the creature with Fiery Rhetoric.
actions.name: Retort

actions.description:
The upstart rattles off talking points at an enemy within 30 feet. The target takes a –2 status penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 minute.

Effect: Fiery Rhetoric
actions.name: Fiery Rhetoric

actions.description:
The political upstart begins a rousing speech which they can Sustain up to 1 minute. Any creature within 30 feet that can hear the speech, must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fascinated with the upstart for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated with the upstart as long as the speech lasts.
actions.name: Fascinating Speech

actions.description: For social encounters involving debate and legal logic, the political upstart is a 3rd-level challenge.
actions.name: Rhetoric Specialist

name: Political Upstart
publicNotes:
Fiery and heady, a political upstart actively pushes against the status quo.

These lone wolves have an aura of mystery, bravado, and swagger.
